# Zuchen Li

> Undergraduate student at the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, majoring in Honors Data Science & Statistics with a minor in History. Aiming for a PhD in HCI / AI. Previously studied Statistics & Computer Science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

Personal homepage: https://lzclink.com/

## Research interests

- Generative AI: music and audio generation, human-GenAI interaction
- Privacy & Security: geolocation attack/defense with diffusion models and VLMs
- Statistical Machine Learning: dimension reduction, Bayesian methods, wearable data analysis
- Climate Science: aerosol-cloud interactions, statistical modeling

## Research experience

- Generative AI for Music and Audio, University of Michigan — Research Assistant (Oct 2025 – present): universal optical music recognition framework; real-time human-GenAI interaction for controllable music generation.
- Ambient Intelligence Lab, University of Michigan — Research Assistant (Oct 2025 – present): privacy-driven geolocation attack/defense with diffusion models and VLMs; IoT sensing with Moiré-pattern optical sensors.
- Energy Distance Dimension Reduction, University of Michigan — URPS (Jan 2025 – present): sufficient dimension reduction on multilevel wearable data; SDR algorithms re-implemented in JAX (7,000× speedup).
- Lab of Atmospheric and Earth System Sciences, Nanjing University — Summer Research Intern (May – Aug 2024): statistical ML for aerosol-cloud interactions.
- E2-E Lab, UIUC — Undergraduate Research Assistant (Aug 2023 – May 2024): airflow experiments, PIV data processing, CFD simulation.

## Beyond research

- Michigan Daily: news reporter, photographer, videographer
- Meteorology enthusiast (ISTORM at UIUC, storm chasing) and History minor
